Gus puts Walt and Jesse back to work cooking meth. Skyler accepts Walt’s criminal enterprise and, with Saul’s help, buys a car wash to launder Walt’s earnings.

古斯让沃尔特和杰西重操旧业，继续制毒。斯凯勒接受了沃尔特的犯罪事业，并在索尔的帮助下买下了一家洗车场，用来洗白沃尔特的非法所得。

Gus wipes out his enemies in Mexico, then turns against Walt. Walt seduces Jesse into murdering Gus. Their first attempt fails, but when Walt offers Hector Salamanca (Mark Margolis) a chance to take revenge on Gus, Hector happily detonates a hidden bomb that kills himself and Gus.

古斯在墨西哥铲除了所有敌人，然后转而与沃尔特对抗。沃尔特诱使杰西去杀古斯。他们的第一次尝试失败了，但当沃尔特给赫克托·萨拉曼卡（马克·马戈利斯饰）一个向古斯复仇的机会时，赫克托欣然引爆了一枚藏匿的炸弹，与古斯同归于尽。

#↩

Season 5, Part 1

第五季，第一部分

Walt, Jesse, Mike Ehrmantraut (Jonathan Banks) and Lydia Rodarte-Quayle (Laura Fraser) partner in the meth business. To get the raw materials they need, the men pull off a train heist. Jesse and Mike want to sell their share to Declan (Louis Ferreira), a Phoenix drug dealer, but Walt refuses. Instead, he cooks for Lydia, who distributes the meth in Europe. She is so successful Walt makes more money than he can count. To end the squabble and finally retire from the drug business, Walt kills Mike and hires Jack (Michael Bowen) and his Nazi biker gang to kill Mike’s associates. Hank, by chance, discovers that Walt is Heisenberg.

沃尔特、杰西、迈克·埃尔曼特劳特（乔纳森·班克斯饰）和莉迪亚·罗达特-奎尔（劳拉·弗雷泽饰）合伙制毒。为了获得所需的原材料，他们策划了一场火车劫案。杰西和迈克想把他们的份额卖给凤凰城的毒贩德克兰（路易斯·费雷拉饰），但沃尔特拒绝了。他转而为莉迪亚制毒，莉迪亚负责在欧洲分销冰毒。莉迪亚的生意非常成功，沃尔特赚得盆满钵满。为了结束争执并彻底退出毒品生意，沃尔特杀死了迈克，并雇佣杰克（迈克尔·鲍文饰）和他的纳粹摩托车帮派除掉迈克的同伙。汉克偶然发现沃尔特就是海森堡。

#↩

Season 5, Part 2

第五季，第二部分

When Hank confronts Walt, Walt backs him down. Hank then turns to Skyler, but she refuses to betray Walt. Seeing trouble coming, Walt buries $80 million in the desert.

汉克与沃尔特对峙时，沃尔特退缩了。汉克转而求助于斯凯勒，但她拒绝背叛沃尔特。预感到麻烦即将到来，沃尔特在沙漠中埋下了8000万美元。

Jack’s gang kills a rival gang and takes their meth production gear. Walt tries to negotiate with Jack, but the Nazi gang turns on him, killing Hank, capturing Jesse, and taking most of Walt’s money.

杰克的团伙杀死了敌对团伙，并缴获了他们的制毒设备。沃尔特试图与杰克谈判，但纳粹团伙却反戈一击，杀死了汉克，抓走了杰西，并抢走了沃尔特的大部分钱。

Walt tries to get Skyler to run off with him, but their marriage ends when she pulls a knife. At first, Walt hides out, but then he changes course, coercing Elliott and Gretchen into caring for his children.

沃尔特试图让斯凯勒跟他私奔，但斯凯勒拔刀相向，他们的婚姻就此结束。起初，沃尔特躲藏起来，但后来他改变了策略，胁迫埃利奥特和格雷琴照顾他的孩子。

At Jack’s gang’s compound, Walt kills Jack and the rest with a remote-control machine gun and frees the imprisoned Jesse. Wounded, he asks Jesse to kill him, but Jesse refuses and drives off. Walt takes a moment to reminisce about his drug empire, then dies.

在杰克团伙的据点，沃尔特用遥控机枪杀死了杰克和其他人，并救出了被囚禁的杰西。身负重伤的沃尔特请求杰西杀了他，但杰西拒绝了，驾车离开。沃尔特回忆起他的毒品帝国，片刻后死去。

Cast Design

铸造设计

Third Circle Roles

第三圈角色

Third circle characters make no independent decisions. They simply react to other more prominent characters and carry out tasks that assist or resist them. Breaking Bad has more than fifty third circle roles. I’ve grouped some of them around the featured character they serve.

第三层级角色没有独立决策权。他们只是对其他更重要的角色做出反应，执行协助或阻碍这些角色的任务。《绝命毒师》中有超过五十个第三层级角色。我根据他们所服务的核心角色对其中一些角色进行了分组。

Walt: Carmen, the high school principal; Hugo, the school janitor; Lawson, the gun dealer; Dr. Delcavoli, the oncologist; Old Joe, the junk dealer; Declan, a drug dealer.

沃尔特：卡门，高中校长；雨果，学校清洁工；劳森，枪支贩子；德尔卡沃利医生，肿瘤科医生；老乔，废品贩子；德克兰，毒贩。

Jesse: the Pinkman family, Brock, Combo, Adam, Wendy, Group Leader, Clovis, Emilio, Spooge and his girlfriend, Drew (the kid on a bike).

杰西：平克曼一家、布洛克、康博、亚当、温迪、组长、克洛维斯、埃米利奥、斯普格和他的女朋友、德鲁（骑自行车的小孩）。

Skyler: Holly, her baby; Walter Jr.; Walter Jr.’s friend, Louis; Pamela, her divorce attorney; Bogdan, the car wash owner.

Skyler：Holly，她的孩子；Walter Jr.；Walter Jr.的朋友Louis；Pamela，她的离婚律师；Bogdan，洗车店老板。

Hank: cops and fellow agents Kalanchoe, Munn, Merkert, Ramey, and Roberts.

汉克：警察和同事卡兰乔、蒙恩、默克特、拉米和罗伯茨。

Gus: fellow criminals Max, Gale, Duane, Ron, Barry, Tyrus, Chris, Dennis, Victor, and Dan.

Gus：同伙罪犯有 Max、Gale、Duane、Ron、Barry、Tyrus、Chris、Dennis、Victor 和 Dan。

Hector: fellow gang members Juan, Tuco, Gaff, Gonzo, No-Doze, Tortuga, and Hector’s retirement home nurse.

赫克托：帮派成员胡安、图科、加夫、冈佐、诺多兹、托尔图加，以及赫克托的养老院护士。

Mike: his daughter-in-law, Stacey, and his granddaughter, Kaylee.

迈克：他的儿媳斯泰西和他的孙女凯莉。

Saul: his staff—Huell, Ed, Francesca, and Kuby.

索尔：他的员工——休尔、艾德、弗朗西斯卡和库比。

Screenwriters rarely describe third circle roles in any detail. To make them specific, directors depend on their casting director’s guidance, along with the costuming and hair styling that gives each role a specific look. After that, it’s up to the actor to make it work.

编剧很少详细描述第三层角色。为了使角色形象鲜明，导演们会依赖选角导演的指导，以及服装和发型设计，从而为每个角色打造独特的造型。之后，就看演员如何演绎了。

Second Circle Roles

第二圈角色

Second circle characters are not complex, but occasionally their actions send story lines in new directions. The writer gives them specific characterizations, and their actors round them out with intriguing personalities, but their inner natures are without contradiction and therefore dimensionless.

第二层级的角色并不复杂，但他们的行为偶尔会推动剧情走向新的方向。作者赋予他们鲜明的个性特征，演员们也用引人入胜的表演使角色更加丰满，但他们的内在本质却缺乏矛盾，因此也显得单薄乏味。

Ted Beneke, for example, starts a love affair with Skyler, who ultimately gives him millions from Walter’s stash. Gretchen and Elliot Schwartz make themselves rich after Walter quits their company. Donald Margolis causes a tragic air disaster in the aftermath of his daughter’s death. Walter’s deeds influence these characters, but they have the final say in the direction their lives take.

例如，泰德·贝内克与斯凯勒坠入爱河，斯凯勒最终从沃尔特的积蓄中给了他数百万美元。沃尔特离开公司后，格雷琴和埃利奥特·施瓦茨夫妇发了财。唐纳德·马戈利斯在女儿去世后引发了一场悲惨的空难。沃尔特的行为影响了这些人物，但最终决定他们人生走向的还是他们自己。

The Breaking Bad cast has seventeen second circle roles:

《绝命毒师》的演员阵容中有十七个只演了一秒钟的角色：

1. Steve Gomez (Steven Michael Quezada), Hank’s DEA partner

2. Gale Boetticher（大卫·科斯塔比尔饰），格斯的冰毒厨师

3.Eladio Vuente（史蒂文·鲍尔饰），贩毒集团大佬

4. 赫克托·萨拉曼卡（马克·马戈利斯饰），前毒枭

5. 图科·萨拉曼卡（雷蒙德·克鲁兹饰），毒枭

6.莱昂内尔·萨拉曼卡（丹尼尔·蒙卡达饰），刺客

8. Krazy-8 Molina（马克西米诺·阿尔涅加饰），毒贩

10. Andrea Cantillo (Emily Rios), Jesse’s girlfriend
10.安德里亚·坎蒂略（艾米丽·里奥斯饰），杰西的女朋友

11. 简·马戈利斯（克里斯滕·里特饰），杰西的女友
12. Badger Mayhew (Matt L. Jones), Jesse’s crew
12. 巴杰·梅休（马特·L·琼斯饰），杰西的船员

14. 泰德·贝内克（克里斯托弗·库辛斯饰），斯凯勒的老板兼情人

15. 唐纳德·马戈利斯（约翰·德·兰西饰），简的父亲

First Circle Roles

第一圈角色

First circle characters often become the protagonists of their own subplots. They have the power and opportunity to make decisions and take major actions that affect the central plot and other story lines. Breaking Bad has ten complex first circle characters:

第一圈人物往往会成为各自支线剧情的主角。他们拥有权力和机会做出影响主线剧情和其他故事情节的重大决定和行动。《绝命毒师》中有十位复杂的第一圈人物：

Todd: One-Dimensional

托德：单向度

Characterization: Todd (Jesse Plemons) is a well-mannered young man who uses violence quickly and efficiently, killing and torturing without hesitation or remorse. He’s a Hannibal Lecter without the IQ—creepy, calm, and unnecessarily polite.

人物刻画：托德（杰西·普莱蒙饰）是一位举止得体的年轻人，但他使用暴力却迅速而高效，杀人或施虐毫不犹豫，也毫无悔意。他就像一个智商低下的汉尼拔·莱克特——令人毛骨悚然，冷静沉着，而且彬彬有礼得过分。

True character: the ultimate sociopath.

真实性格：终极反社会人格。

Todd helps the audience measure the limits of Walt’s evil. Sociopathology runs a spectrum of severity from mild to craven. Walt is sociopathic but only to a degree; Todd waits at the dark extreme. Walt takes no pleasure in the suffering he causes; Todd thrives on cruelty. Walt has feelings, even passions; Todd none.

托德帮助观众衡量沃尔特邪恶的程度。反社会人格的严重程度从轻微到卑鄙不等。沃尔特有反社会倾向，但程度有限；托德则处于黑暗的极端。沃尔特不会从他造成的痛苦中获得任何快感；托德却以残忍为乐。沃尔特有感情，甚至有激情；托德却没有。

Dimension: Polite/Pitiless.

维度：礼貌/无情。

Lydia Rodarte-Quayle: One-Dimensional

莉迪亚·罗达特-奎尔：单向度

Characterization: Lydia (Laura Fraser) is a tense, aloof, corporate executive.

人物刻画：莉迪亚（劳拉·弗雷泽饰）是一位紧张、冷漠的企业高管。

True character: She steals raw materials from her company and sells them to drug dealers. A thief and loner with no relationships, she will kill anyone in her way.

真实性格：她从公司偷窃原材料，然后卖给毒贩。她是个孤僻的窃贼，没有任何人际关系，会毫不犹豫地杀掉任何挡路的人。

Dimension: Refined/Brutal.

维度：精致/粗犷。

Mike Ehrmantraut: One-Dimensional

迈克·埃尔曼特劳特：单向度

Characterization: Mike (Jonathan Banks) adores his granddaughter as he executes his crime craft with calculated efficiency.

人物刻画：迈克（乔纳森·班克斯饰）非常疼爱他的孙女，同时他以精明的效率执行犯罪活动。

True character: For Mike, breaking the law is just another way to make a living. Loyal to his employer and employees, he never harms innocent bystanders. He’s a criminal antihero with a code of honor.

真实性格：对迈克来说，违法犯罪不过是另一种谋生手段。他忠于雇主和雇员，从不伤害无辜的旁观者。他是一个恪守荣誉准则的罪犯反英雄。

Dimension: Warm-blooded/Cold-blooded.

维度：温血/冷血。

Saul Goodman: One-Dimensional

索尔·古德曼：单向度

Characterization: Saul (Bob Odenkirk) is flamboyant in dress, outrageous in a courtroom, self-marketed in blaring TV commercials. He leverages the ludicrous in desperate situations; his sarcasm provides the show’s comic relief.

人物刻画：索尔（鲍勃·奥登科克饰）衣着浮夸，在法庭上言辞激烈，还经常在电视广告中大肆宣传自己。他擅长在绝境中利用荒诞不经的手段；他的讽刺挖苦为剧集增添了喜剧色彩。

True character: His real name is Jimmy McGill, but he took “Saul Goodman” because people trust Jewish attorneys. Saul is a skilled lawyer who gives sound advice and finds ingenious loopholes to solve his clients’ villainous problems.

真实身份：他的真名叫吉米·麦吉尔，但他化名“索尔·古德曼”，因为人们信任犹太律师。索尔是一位技艺精湛的律师，他能给出中肯的建议，并能巧妙地找到法律漏洞，帮助客户解决棘手的难题。

He also provides services such as evidence removal, loot stashing, false bank accounts, false documents, bribery, intimidations, relocation, and other crimes-for-hire.

他还提供诸如清除证据、藏匿赃物、伪造银行账户、伪造文件、行贿、恐吓、搬迁以及其他雇佣犯罪等服务。

Dimension: Criminal/Lawyer.

维度：刑事/律师。

Marie Schrader: Two-Dimensional

玛丽·施拉德：二维

Characterization: Marie (Betsy Brandt), a medical technician who loves her husband, Hank, her sister’s family, and all things purple.

人物介绍：玛丽（贝茜·布兰特饰），一名医疗技术员，热爱她的丈夫汉克、她姐姐一家以及所有紫色的东西。

True character: She’s a kleptomaniac who fills her empty life with the excitement of petty thefts. She feels dependent on her husband and morally inferior to her sister. When Skyler’s crimes are exposed, she glows with moral superiority. When her husband dies, she finds great personal power and independence.

真实性格：她是个有盗窃癖的人，靠偷窃来填补空虚的生活。她觉得自己依赖丈夫，道德上不如妹妹。当斯凯勒的罪行被揭穿后，她却洋溢着道德优越感。丈夫去世后，她获得了巨大的个人力量和独立性。

Dimensions: Dependent/Independent, Weak/Powerful.

维度：依赖型/独立型，弱型/强型。

Walter White Jr.: Two-Dimensional

小沃尔特·怀特：二维

Characterization: Walter Jr. (R. J. Mitte) is a teenager with cerebral palsy.

人物介绍：沃尔特·Jr.（R. J. Mitte 饰）是一位患有脑瘫的青少年。

True character: Caught between battling parents, the boy’s loyalty shifts from his mother to his father and back again. When hit by the discovery that his father is a meth dealer who killed his uncle, he rolls with the shock, then turns it into his moment of maturation and individuation as he changes from protected victim to protector of his mother and sister.

真实性格：夹在争吵不休的父母之间，男孩的忠诚在母亲和父亲之间摇摆不定。当他发现父亲是杀害叔叔的冰毒贩子时，他先是震惊不已，随后将之转化为成长和自我实现的契机，从一个受保护的受害者转变为母亲和妹妹的保护者。

Dimensions: Child/Adult, Protected/Protector.

尺寸：儿童/成人，受保护/保护者。

Skyler White: Three-Dimensional

斯凯勒·怀特：三维

Characterization: Skyler (Anna Gunn) is an attractive housewife and the mother of a disabled son who earns cash selling items on eBay and working as a part-time bookkeeper.

人物介绍：斯凯勒（安娜·冈饰）是一位有魅力的家庭主妇，也是一位残疾儿子的母亲，她通过在 eBay 上出售物品和兼职做簿记员来赚钱。

True character: Some claim that Skyler is a battered wife who’s been walking on eggshells throughout her marriage. Others accuse her of abusing, henpecking, and belittling Walt.

真实性格：有人说斯凯勒是个饱受虐待的妻子，婚后一直小心翼翼，如履薄冰。也有人指责她虐待、唠叨、贬低沃尔特。

I would argue both are true. Like many marriages, Walt and Skyler are mutually abusive and mutually supportive. Secretly, each feels superior to the other; both feel humiliated by life (he more than she); each takes life’s disappointments out on the other.

我认为两者都对。就像许多婚姻一样，沃尔特和斯凯勒既互相虐待又互相扶持。他们内心深处都觉得自己比对方优越；两人都感到生活屈辱（沃尔特比斯凯勒更甚）；两人都把生活中的失望发泄在对方身上。

But then comes Walter’s cancer, followed by his secret criminal life. Skyler strikes back by seducing her boss. Then, when Walt’s crimes bring in millions, Skyler excuses him, rationalizing that he did it for the family. She launders the loot and creates the videotape that coerces Hank into silence.

但随后沃尔特患上了癌症，紧接着他又开始了秘密的犯罪生涯。斯凯勒为了报复，勾引了自己的老板。之后，当沃尔特的犯罪活动为她带来了数百万美元的收益时，斯凯勒却为他开脱，理由是他是为了家族利益。她洗白了赃款，并制作了那盘迫使汉克保持沉默的录像带。

Some might call her a Stockholm syndrome victim who identifies with her oppressor, but if she were really a battered wife, how did she become the fast-thinking, cool-headed businesswoman who launders millions through her car wash scam?

有些人可能会称她为斯德哥尔摩综合症的受害者，认同了她的施暴者，但如果她真的是一位遭受家暴的妻子，她又是如何成为一位思维敏捷、冷静沉着的女商人，并通过洗车骗局洗钱数百万美元的呢？

These contradictions reveal a complex character whose mind can twist negatives into positives, such as “This is bad but not that bad. Walt promises to give up crime, so if I can launder the money, the other problems will disappear, and Walt will be Walt again. It’s just a phase.”

这些矛盾揭示了一个复杂的人物性格，他的思维能够将负面因素转化为正面因素，例如“这很糟糕，但也没那么糟糕。沃尔特承诺不再犯罪，所以如果我能洗白这笔钱，其他问题就会消失，沃尔特也会变回以前的沃尔特。这只是暂时的。”

With the exception of Walter Jr., most Breaking Bad characters are either immoral, morally elastic, or, like Skyler, morally split: Intellectually she knows right from wrong, but emotionally she has no center. If she can get away with crime, she’s happy to be a criminal. She drifts with her feelings, then acts.

除了沃尔特·小沃尔特之外，《绝命毒师》中的大多数角色要么道德沦丧，要么道德摇摆不定，要么像斯凯勒一样道德分裂：理智上她能分辨是非，但情感上却摇摆不定。只要犯罪不被追究责任，她就乐于作恶。她随心所欲，然后采取行动。

Dimensions: Rational/Emotional, Loving/Punishing, Moral/Immoral.

维度：理性/感性，爱/惩罚，道德/不道德。

Gus Fring: Three-Dimensional

格斯·弗林：三维

Characterization: Gus (Giancarlo Esposito) is a Chilean-born, well-mannered restaurant owner, civic leader, and philanthropic sponsor of an antidrug charity. He’s generous, straightforward, and pro–law enforcement.

人物介绍：格斯（吉安卡洛·埃斯波西托饰）是一位出生于智利的彬彬有礼的餐厅老板、社区领袖，也是一家禁毒慈善机构的慷慨赞助人。他慷慨大方、为人坦率，并且支持执法部门。

True character: Gus runs his crime enterprise through the cold-blooded execution of Machiavellian stratagems. The inner force that drives him is revenge for the murder of Max, his lover and partner in crime.

真实性格：格斯凭借冷酷无情的权谋手段运作他的犯罪帝国。驱使他行动的内在动力是对爱人兼犯罪伙伴麦克斯的复仇，麦克斯惨遭杀害。

Dimensions: Outer Good / Inner Evil, Low Key in public / High Key in private, Straightforward/Scheming.

维度：外在善良/内在邪恶，公开场合低调/私下里高调，直率/阴险。

Hank: Four-Dimensional

汉克：四维

Characterization: To his coworkers, Hank (Dean Norris) radiates the high energy of a boisterous DEA agent. At home, he collects minerals, brews his own beer, and loves his wife.

人物刻画：在同事眼中，汉克（迪恩·诺里斯饰）是一位精力充沛、热情奔放的缉毒局特工。在家，他喜欢收集矿物、自酿啤酒，并且深爱着他的妻子。

True character: Beneath this flippant, ill-mannered racist lives a skilled detective. He’s strong around men but weak around women, especially his wife. His inner nature pits his courage against PTSD and panic attacks, while he wages a second inner war between his analytical mind and his explosive temper.

真实性格：在这个轻浮、粗鲁、种族歧视的外表下，隐藏着一位技艺高超的侦探。他面对男性时游刃有余，但在女性面前却显得脆弱，尤其是他的妻子。他的内心深处，勇气与创伤后应激障碍和恐慌症的折磨交织在一起；与此同时，他理性的头脑与暴躁的脾气之间也存在着激烈的冲突。

Dimensions: Crass/Intelligent, Weak/Strong, Tough/Panicky, Analytical/Explosive.

维度：粗鲁/聪明，软弱/坚强，坚韧/恐慌，分析型/爆发型。

Jesse: Six-Dimensional

杰西：六维

Characterization: Jesse Pinkman (Aaron Paul), Walt’s former student and cooking partner, talks in playful slang, wears trendy clothes, plays video games, enjoys parties and techno-toys, listens to rap and rock, and uses recreational drugs. His own family disowned him over his drug use, but he loves his girlfriends and protects their endangered children.

人物介绍：杰西·平克曼（亚伦·保尔饰）是沃尔特的学生兼制毒搭档，他说话带着几分戏谑的俚语，穿着时髦的衣服，玩电子游戏，喜欢派对和各种高科技玩具，听说唱和摇滚乐，还吸食毒品。他的家人因为他吸毒而与他断绝关系，但他深爱着他的女友们，并保护着她们身处险境的孩子们。

True character: Jesse is the only cast member who sees the moral schism at the heart of Breaking Bad . The moment he kills their rival meth cook, he realizes his crimes are not acts of self-preservation. He has tied himself to an evil man, and his series-long struggle to break free arcs him from immoral to moral and from self-destructive to self-possessed.

杰西的真实性格：他是《绝命毒师》中唯一一个真正看清道德困境核心的演员。当他杀死竞争对手的制毒师时，他意识到自己的罪行并非出于自保。他把自己绑在了一个邪恶的人身上，而贯穿全剧的挣脱束缚的挣扎，也让他从不道德走向道德，从自我毁灭走向自我掌控。

Dimensions: Undereducated/Street-smart, Impulsive/Cautious, Hedonistic/Stoic, Shy/Bold, Weak-willed/Strong-willed, Risks his life for money / Then throws it away.

维度：教育程度低/街头智慧，冲动/谨慎，享乐主义/坚忍，害羞/大胆，意志薄弱/意志坚强，为钱冒险/然后挥霍无度。

A character of this complexity needs a large supporting cast to bring out his multitude of outer traits, plus his six dimensions and arc of change, all told over extensive performance time. The first, second, and third circle characters who surround and interact with Jesse number into the dozens.

像杰西这样复杂的人物需要庞大的配角阵容来展现他众多的外在特征、六个维度以及成长历程，所有这些都需要在较长的演出时间内完整呈现。围绕杰西并与他互动的第一、第二和第三圈角色多达数十人。

Walter White: Sixteen-Dimensional

沃尔特·怀特：十六维空间

Characterization: Walt (Bryan Cranston) is a fifty-year-old failed scientist turned high school teacher. He’s dedicated to his profession and uses his logical, eclectic knowledge to enrich his teaching. At home, he’s a kind husband and father, suffering from lung cancer.

人物介绍：沃尔特（布莱恩·克兰斯顿饰）是一位五十岁的失败科学家，如今转行成为高中教师。他热爱自己的职业，并运用自己逻辑严密、博学多才的知识来丰富教学内容。在家中，他是一位慈爱的丈夫和父亲，但身患肺癌。

The Six Dimensions of Jesse Pinkman
杰西·平克曼的六个维度
Map of Jesse’s Redemption Plot
杰西救赎剧情图

True character: Walt begins as an incomplete character driven by a need for an intense experience at the absolute limits of human possibility. He’s a fiercely proud egoist craving recognition. His nonstop lies provide him with rationalizations for the cruelest of actions. In his self-deceived mind, he’s an apostle of family values, free enterprise, and scientific progress. In fact, he’s ruthless and violent, killing with little regret as he dreams of building his crime empire.

真实性格：沃尔特最初是一个不完整的人物，他渴望体验人类极限的极致快感。他是一个极度自负的利己主义者，渴望得到认可。他谎话连篇，为自己最残忍的行为寻找借口。在他自欺欺人的认知里，他是家庭价值观、自由企业和科学进步的拥护者。事实上，他冷酷无情、暴力成性，为了建立自己的犯罪帝国，杀人几乎毫无悔意。

The Sixteen Dimensions of Walter White
沃尔特·怀特的十六个维度

Dimensions: Walt’s sixteen dimensions divide into contradictions of characterization versus true self and contradictions of true self versus hidden self.

维度：沃尔特的十六个维度分为角色化与真实自我之间的矛盾，以及真实自我与隐藏自我之间的矛盾。

Dimensions: Characterization Versus True Self
维度：角色塑造与真我
1. Family man yet sociopath.
1.顾家的男人，但却是反社会人格者。
2. Gentle yet violent.
2. 温柔而又暴力。
3. Workingman yet entrepreneur. He’s a teacher who builds a drug empire worth hundreds of millions.
3. 他既是工人又是企业家。他是一名教师，却建立了一个价值数亿美元的毒品帝国。
4. Scientific yet criminal. For some naïve reason, we tend to believe that scientists are moral. Walt is a lethal nerd, the kind of nerd who makes other nerds proud.
4. 既是科学家又是罪犯。出于某种天真的原因，我们往往认为科学家是道德高尚的。沃尔特是个致命的书呆子，那种会让其他书呆子引以为傲的书呆子。
5. Apologetic yet never really sorry.
5. 口头上道歉，但实际上从未真正感到抱歉。
6. He imposes strict rules on others yet doesn’t hesitate to break the law.
6. 他要求别人遵守严格的规则，自己却毫不犹豫地违法。
7. He demands loyalty yet betrays virtually everyone.
7. 他要求别人对他忠诚，但他却背叛了几乎所有人。
8. He demands the truth yet lies nonstop with consummate skill.
8. 他要求真相，却又谎话连篇，技艺高超。
9. He idealizes the way science enriches life yet corrupts science to destroy human beings.
9. 他理想化了科学丰富生活的方式，但又认为科学会腐蚀人心，最终毁灭人类。

These contradictions are not Walter’s most profound dimensions because they only contradict his characterization with his true character. The deepest dimensions do not show on the surface of behavior. They can be only implied beneath a character’s actions.

这些矛盾并非沃尔特性格中最深刻的层面，因为它们仅仅与他塑造的角色形象相悖。性格中最深层的层面不会显露于表面行为，只能隐喻于人物的言行之中。

Dimensions: Private Self Versus Hidden Self
维度：私密自我与隐藏自我
1. Because he’s dying of cancer, he risks his life without hesitation, yet because he’s dying of cancer, he loves life and strives to live it to the limit.
1. 因为他身患癌症，所以他毫不犹豫地冒着生命危险；然而，正因为他身患癌症，所以他热爱生命，努力活到生命的尽头。
2. He’s rational yet impulsive; he carefully estimates the odds, then gambles with his life against all odds.
2. 他理性而冲动；他仔细评估了各种可能性，然后不顾一切地拿自己的生命去冒险。
3. He’s emotionally cool yet explodes in high anger and grief when he can’t get his way.
3. 他表面上情绪冷静，但当他无法如愿以偿时，就会爆发出极大的愤怒和悲伤。
4. He’s self-confident and proud yet self-doubting and humble.
4. 他既自信又骄傲，但同时又自我怀疑且谦逊。
5. He has penetrating insight into other people but virtually no self-awareness.
5. 他对他人有敏锐的洞察力，但几乎没有自我意识。
6. He loves his family and devotes himself to their well-being. Yet to satisfy his narcissistic needs, he constantly puts his family in life-and-death danger, as well as his partner, Jesse, and his brother-in-law, Hank. In the conflict between self and others, he consistently chooses self.
6. 他爱他的家人，并全心全意地为他们着想。然而，为了满足他自恋的需求，他不断地将家人、伴侣杰西以及妹夫汉克置于生死攸关的境地。在自我与他人的冲突中，他总是选择自我。
7. Primary dimension: His greatest inner contradiction is between himself and his alter ego, between who he thinks he is and who he really is, between Walt and Heisenberg.
7. 主要维度：他最大的内在矛盾在于他自己和他的另一个自我之间，在于他认为自己是谁和他真正是谁之间，在于沃尔特和海森堡之间。

Walt tries to compartmentalize these two guys: the cold, calculating drug dealing Heisenberg on one side, and the well-meaning father and husband Walter White on the other. For example, when he begs Jack to save Hank’s life, he’s Walt, but when he tells Jack to kill Jesse, he’s Heisenberg.

沃尔特试图将这两个身份彻底区分开来：一边是冷酷无情的毒贩海森堡，另一边是心地善良的父亲和丈夫沃尔特·怀特。例如，当他恳求杰克救汉克的命时，他是沃尔特；但当他命令杰克杀了杰西时，他又是海森堡。

The Walter White side kidnaps Holly because his infant daughter is the only person left in his life who might someday love him, but thanks to her, he finally sees the truth. He realizes that he did not do it for his family; he did it for his true self, for Heisenberg. When he returns Holly to her mother, he throws away his last piece of Walt. From that point on, he’s all Heisenberg.

沃尔特·怀特绑架霍莉，是因为他年幼的女儿是他生命中唯一可能爱他的人。但多亏了霍莉，他最终看清了真相。他意识到自己并非为了家人而作恶，而是为了他真正的自我，为了海森堡。当他把霍莉还给她的母亲时，他彻底抛弃了自己身上最后一点沃尔特的影子。从那一刻起，他完全变成了海森堡。

The creation of sixteen dimensions in Breaking Bad ’s protagonist needed sixty-two hours of constant interaction between Walter White and one of the largest supporting casts in storytelling history. To help make sense of this mass, I’ve reworked Walter’s gangster plot map, putting all the characters who help his enterprise in the first circle, all the characters who hinder his venture in the second ring, Skyler as both in between, and the cops and gangster cohorts in the outer reaches.

《绝命毒师》的主角沃尔特·怀特拥有十六个截然不同的性格维度，这需要六十二个小时的持续互动，而他的配角阵容之庞大，堪称故事史上之最。为了更好地理解这个庞大的人物群像，我重新绘制了沃尔特的黑帮阴谋图：将所有帮助他的人放在第一层，所有阻碍他的人放在第二层，斯凯勒则介于两者之间，而警察和黑帮同伙则位于最外层。

Walter’s Gangster Plot
沃尔特的黑帮阴谋
#↩

Walter White’s Character Arc

沃尔特·怀特的角色弧线

I titled the central plot of Breaking Bad The Triumph of Heisenberg . Heisenberg is not a new self. Walter has suppressed him all his life. Once he’s finally let out with room to grow, Heisenberg takes on a life of his own. He destroys Walt and everything Walt values.

我将《绝命毒师》的核心情节命名为“海森堡的胜利”。海森堡并非一个全新的自我。沃尔特一生都在压抑着他。一旦他终于获得释放和成长的空间，海森堡便会彻底失控。他摧毁了沃尔特以及沃尔特所珍视的一切。

On the surface, Breaking Bad ’s core story seems to be a Degeneration Plot that arcs Walt from good guy to bad guy. Some, however, would argue that the last episodes redeem him.

表面上看，《绝命毒师》的核心故事似乎是一个“堕落”情节，讲述了沃尔特从好人逐渐堕落成坏人的过程。然而，也有人认为，最后几集让他重获救赎。

After five seasons of revelations, we realize that the shambling classroom nobody he showed his students, the nebbish he was to his brother-in-law, and the milquetoast who shared a bed with his wife were his disguise. Heisenberg, his drug lord nom de guerre, is Walt’s true self.

经过五季的剧情揭秘，我们终于明白，他在学生面前表现得笨拙不堪、不谙世事，在姐夫面前表现得唯唯诺诺，在妻子面前表现得唯唯诺诺，这一切都是他的伪装。海森堡，这个毒枭的化名，才是沃尔特真正的自我。

When he cuts the Walter White side out of himself and does terrible things, he’s fine. At the Season 1 climax, after he kills for the first time, he comes home to make love to his wife with more passion than he’s ever known.

当他彻底摆脱沃尔特·怀特的阴暗面，去做那些可怕的事情时，他却安然无恙。在第一季的高潮部分，他第一次杀人后，回到家与妻子缠绵，激情远胜以往。

But when he tries to cut Heisenberg out of himself, he erupts with rage.

但当他试图将海森堡从自己身上剔除时，他却勃然大怒。

The Breaking Bad climax tilts Walt’s Degeneration Plot toward Redemption. It resolves the Walter/Heisenberg contradiction by merging the two into one complete character who does good with the means of evil.

《绝命毒师》的高潮部分将沃尔特的堕落之路引向了救赎。它通过将沃尔特和海森堡融合为一个完整的人物，解决了沃尔特/海森堡之间的矛盾，使之成为一个能够运用邪恶手段行善的人。

But Walt is not an antihero. He is a Satan-hero who finds fulfillment but with great irony. He loses everything but gains something few of us ever know: life lived to the limit of human experience.

但沃尔特并非反英雄。他是一位撒旦式的英雄，最终获得了圆满的人生，却充满了讽刺意味。他失去了一切，却获得了我们大多数人永远无法企及的东西：活出了人类经验的极限。

#↩

Wrap-Up

包起来

Breaking Bad ’s story-driven meanings and dimensionality of cast are so powerfully human, the series as written would have been a success at any time. But why did the series’ stupendous popularity exceed all expectation? Because, I believe, Vince Gilligan said something that needed saying when it was said. Gilligan’s Breaking Bad satirizes modern entrepreneurial ideology.

《绝命毒师》的故事驱动意义和人物塑造的立体感极具感染力，即使按照剧本创作，这部剧集在任何时候都足以获得成功。但为什么这部剧集的惊人人气会超出所有人的预期呢？我认为，是因为文斯·吉利根在当时说出了某些亟需表达的话。吉利根的《绝命毒师》讽刺了现代创业者的意识形态。

In 2008 two things happened: the Great Recession and the premiere season of Breaking Bad . In both worlds, real and fictional, some people get a lot; the rest get stiffed. In such times, is it any wonder an audience would empathize with a man who does whatever it takes to win back what he feels should have been his from the start?

2008年发生了两件事：经济大衰退和《绝命毒师》第一季的播出。无论在现实世界还是虚构世界，总有人获益良多，而其他人则一无所有。在这样的时代背景下，观众会对一个不惜一切代价夺回他认为原本就属于自己的一切的男人产生共鸣，也就不足为奇了。

Walt was exiled from the hierarchy of science by the treachery of his partners and his bitterly stubborn pride. He knows in his heart that he is superior, and when by chance he discovers his true calling, he fights to claim his rightful place among the world’s elite. He is an empire builder out of an Ayn Rand novel, biding his time amid the weaklings, plotting his revenge.

沃尔特因合伙人的背叛和自己顽固不化的自尊心而被逐出科学界的权力中心。他内心深处深知自己高人一等，当偶然间发现自己真正的使命时，他便奋力争取在世界精英中占据一席之地。他就像安·兰德小说中走出来的帝国缔造者，潜伏在弱者之中，伺机复仇。

Using superior technical know-how, Walt creates a start-up company that makes a boutique product better than the competition. No easy task. Then this self-made man has to deal with unreliable partners and ruthless competitors. He is constantly beset by raw material shortages on one hand and supply-chain problems on the other. Plus that bane of all entrepreneurs: government regulation. In his case, the U.S. Drug Enforcement Agency.

凭借卓越的技术专长，沃尔特创办了一家初创公司，生产出比竞争对手更胜一筹的精品产品。这绝非易事。这位白手起家的企业家还不得不应对不可靠的合作伙伴和冷酷无情的竞争对手。一方面，他不断受到原材料短缺和供应链问题的困扰。此外，还有所有创业者都面临的噩梦：政府监管。就他而言，监管他的是美国缉毒局。

Like all self-made men, Walt must deal with stupid people who feel threatened by his brilliance and cannot grasp his vision.

像所有白手起家的人一样，沃尔特必须面对那些因他的才华而感到威胁，却无法理解他的远见的愚蠢之人。

In Season 1, everyone was a sinner: Marie steals from stores while her husband bends the law. Virtually the whole cast was composed of criminal businessmen, criminal lawyers, corrupt cops, drug dealers, and drug addicts.

第一季里，人人都是罪人：玛丽偷商店的东西，她丈夫则游走在法律边缘。几乎所有角色都是犯罪商人、犯罪律师、腐败警察、毒贩和吸毒者。

So at first Walt’s meth cooking and murder seemed like a matter of degree. But Vince Gilligan made us realize that degrees matter.

所以一开始，沃尔特制冰毒和杀人似乎只是程度上的差异。但文斯·吉利根让我们意识到，程度很重要。

Walter isn’t just another sinner. From his dark soul he unleashes destruction on the city and his family. He commits multiple murders and creates drug addicts. Anyone, like Jesse, who sees his true face knows that he is Satan.

沃尔特并非普通的罪人。他内心黑暗，给这座城市和他的家人带来了毁灭性的灾难。他犯下多起谋杀案，并制造了许多吸毒者。任何像杰西一样看清他真面目的人都知道，他就是撒旦。

Yet, the genius of the series is that the audience empathizes. We identify with this Prince of Darkness. Like millions of viewers, Walter bore a lifetime of deep anger and resentment. He screams at his wife that no one respects his greatness. Like all those who have been ground down by the system, Walt’s every action cries: “Recognize me!”

然而，这部剧的精妙之处在于它能让观众产生共鸣。我们与这位“黑暗王子”产生了共鸣。和数百万观众一样，沃尔特一生都背负着深深的愤怒和怨恨。他冲着妻子咆哮，说没有人尊重他的伟大。就像所有被体制压垮的人一样，沃尔特的每一个举动都在呐喊：“认清我！”

Breaking Bad places Walt in the company of other disrupters and innovators who started out in garages, then created products that shook up society. (Not that I’m suggesting Mark Zuckerberg and Steve Jobs are drug dealers—although their products do seem rather habit-forming.)

《绝命毒师》将沃尔特置于一群颠覆者和创新者的行列，他们起步于车库，最终创造出撼动社会的产品。（我并不是说马克·扎克伯格和史蒂夫·乔布斯是毒贩——尽管他们的产品确实很容易让人上瘾。）

Walter White became a satisfying character because he takes care of his family, saves Jesse’s life, destroys Jack’s Nazi biker gang, and ends his empire on his terms, not the law’s.

沃尔特·怀特之所以成为一个令人满意的角色，是因为他照顾家人，拯救了杰西的生命，摧毁了杰克的纳粹摩托车帮派，并按照自己的方式（而不是法律的方式）结束了他的帝国。

The core genre of Breaking Bad is the Evolution Plot, the positive side on a humanity arc. Ultimately, Walt’s need for fulfillment of his human potential and completion of his inner nature is met.

《绝命毒师》的核心类型是“进化剧情”，即人性弧线中积极的一面。最终，沃尔特实现自身潜能、完善内心世界的需求得到了满足。

#↩

CONCLUSION: THE REVOLUTIONARY WRITER

结论：革命作家

The desire to be an artist, to be someone who puts beauty before money, often brings rejection and with that poverty and with that ridicule. These fears have broken the will of many a gifted writer. To face them, an author must become not a rebel but a revolutionary. Rebels resent authority because they feel unloved, unappreciated. A true revolutionary’s revolution happens within herself, out of sight and alone. She knows her full worth and needs no one to tell her what it is. Rebels want to overthrow authority so they can put themselves in its place. A silent revolutionary has no such wish; a solitary revolutionary is a humanist.

渴望成为艺术家，渴望将美置于金钱之上，往往意味着拒绝，随之而来的是贫困和嘲讽。这些恐惧击垮了许多才华横溢的作家。为了克服这些恐惧，作家必须成为革命者，而非叛逆者。叛逆者憎恨权威，因为他们感到不被爱，不被赏识。真正的革命者在内心深处进行革命，隐于幕后，独自一人。她深知自身的价值，无需他人指点。叛逆者想要推翻权威，以便取而代之。而沉默的革命者则没有这样的愿望；孤独的革命者是人道主义者。

She’s not fanatic, she’s independent.

她不是狂热分子，她很独立。

She believes in the centrality of human creativity and the highest values of consciousness, beginning with compassion.

她相信人类创造力的核心地位和意识的最高价值，而同情心则是这一切的基础。

She enjoys good company. In fact, her insights into friends and acquaintances inspired her first fascinations with character.

她喜欢与人交往。事实上，她对朋友和熟人的洞察力激发了她最初对人物性格的兴趣。

She’s skeptical but not cynical. She distains the lies people believe, the delusions they substitute for reality. Seeing the limits of all groups, all societies, she frees herself from soil and blood, from blind loyalty to nation, class, race, party, religion… even family.

她心存怀疑，但并不愤世嫉俗。她鄙视人们深信不疑的谎言，鄙视他们用幻想来代替现实。看清所有群体、所有社会的局限性后，她摆脱了血缘和土地的束缚，不再盲目效忠于国家、阶级、种族、政党、宗教……甚至家庭。

She never copies life. Real people may inspire, but they’re only a start and never enough.

她从不照搬生活。真实的人物或许能给人启发，但这仅仅是个开始，远远不够。

She works to master her craft, letting instinct and insight show the way.

她努力精进技艺，让直觉和洞察力指引方向。

She never settles for surface characterizations. Instead, she explores the hidden life in ways she never could with anyone she knows to create characters we would all love to know.

她从不满足于肤浅的人物刻画。相反，她以自己从未对任何认识的人做到的方式，探索人物的内心世界，塑造出我们都渴望了解的角色。

She never shows off. She never pens anything that calls attention to her writing as writing.

她从不炫耀自己的写作技巧。她从不写任何会让人注意到她写作水平的作品。

She knows that eccentricity is not originality.

她明白，古怪并不等于原创。

She knows self-knowledge is her truest source of character, so she spends time within.

她知道自我认知是她性格最真实的来源，所以她花时间与自己相处。

She does not limit her sources of inspiration. She pockets ideas wherever she finds them—in happenings, in other people, in herself.

她从不限制自己的灵感来源。她会把任何发现的灵感都记在心里——从发生的事件中，从他人身上，甚至从她自己身上。

She explores conflict and revels in complexities.

她探索冲突，沉浸于复杂性之中。

She illuminates the human spirit in wondrous breadths and profound depths.

她以惊人的广度和深刻的内涵照亮了人类精神。

She never ends the storied paths she gives her characters until they fulfill the promise of their humanity.

她从不让笔下人物的故事走向终结，直到他们实现人性的承诺。

The revolutionary writer fills our evenings with delight.

这位具有革命性意义的作家为我们带来了愉悦的夜晚。

I see the bottom of the last page rising to meet me, so before time runs out, I lift a glass: Here’s to you, the writers—navigators of story, explorers of character. May you find your way through the wilds of humankind, unearth buried treasure, then return safely home again.

我看到最后一页的底部缓缓升起，仿佛要与我相遇，于是在时间耗尽之前，我举起酒杯：敬你们，作家们——故事的引路人，人物的探索者。愿你们穿越人类世界的荒野，挖掘出埋藏的宝藏，然后平安归来。

ACKNOWLEDGMENTS

致谢

First drafts are not just rough, they’re raw. My thanks to Ashleigh Blake and the members of the Sherman Library Book Club—Andrea O’Connor, Suzanne Ashley, Corinne Kevorkian, Catherine D’Andrea—who explored thick, primitive pages and emerged with idea rescuing insights.

初稿不仅粗糙，而且未经雕琢。感谢阿什利·布莱克以及谢尔曼图书馆读书俱乐部的成员——安德里亚·奥康纳、苏珊娜·阿什利、科琳·凯沃尔基安和凯瑟琳·德安德里亚——她们翻阅了厚厚的、原始的稿纸，并从中提炼出拯救灵感的真知灼见。

No one has a sharper eye for the flow of logic through a chapter, within a paragraph or from capital letter to full stop than my editor, Marcia Freedman. I am, as always, in her debt.

没有人比我的编辑玛西娅·弗里德曼更擅长把握章节、段落乃至句号之间的逻辑流畅性。我一如既往地感激她。

Equally, I thank design artist Oliver Brown for rendering qualities of cast and character with graphic clarity.

同样，我感谢设计艺术家 Oliver Brown 以清晰的图形表现力描绘了演员和角色的特质。

Lastly, if someone reads a first draft and then tells you white lies, it doesn’t really help. So with deepest gratitude, I thank my friend Christa Echtle for her immense intelligence and intrinsic honesty.

最后，如果有人读了初稿后还编造一些善意的谎言，那其实并没有什么帮助。因此，我怀着最深的感激之情，感谢我的朋友克丽斯塔·埃克特尔，感谢她卓越的智慧和真诚的品格。

ABOUT THE AUTHOR

关于作者

Robert McKee is a Fulbright Scholar and recipient of an International Moving Image Book Award. Programs he wrote and presented for British television have been twice nominated for the BAFTA, and this award was given to J’Accuse: Citizen Kane . His pilot screenplay Abraham launched the TV series The Bible . McKee has lectured on the art of storytelling throughout the world. His former students have won more than 60 Academy Awards, 200 Emmy Awards, 100 WGA awards, and 50 DGA awards, along with the Pulitzer and Booker Prizes.

罗伯特·麦基是富布赖特学者，也是国际动态影像图书奖的获得者。他为英国电视台创作并主持的节目曾两次获得英国电影学院奖（BAFTA）提名，最终凭借《我控诉：公民凯恩》获奖。他的试播剧本《亚伯拉罕》开启了电视剧《圣经》的创作。麦基曾在世界各地讲授故事讲述的艺术。他的学生曾荣获超过60项奥斯卡金像奖、200项艾美奖、100项美国编剧工会奖和50项美国导演工会奖，以及普利策奖和布克奖。

GLOSSARY

词汇表

Action: Anything a character does mentally or physically in a purposeful effort to cause change.

行动：角色为了促成改变而进行的任何心理或生理活动。

Activity: Anything a character does without purpose. Purposeless deeds and thoughts kill time but change nothing.

活动：角色无目的所做的任何行为。无目的的举动和想法只会浪费时间，却不会改变任何事情。

Agent Self: That aspect of the mind that carries out a character’s actions. The agent self does what the core self wants done while the core self sits back, observant and aware. The core self calls its agent self “I” as in “I did that; I’m doing this; I will get that done.”

行动主体：指执行角色行为的心理层面。行动主体执行核心自我的意愿，而核心自我则在一旁观察和感知。核心自我称行动主体为“我”，例如“我做了这件事”、“我正在做这件事”、“我会完成这件事”。

Allegorical Character: A role that represents a specific facet of a universal concept. If, for example, an author wanted to dramatize the idea of Creativity, each cast member might symbolize one of the arts: Poetry, Painting, Dance, Music, Sculpture, Cinema, Theatre, and the like.

寓言人物：代表某个普遍概念的特定方面的角色。例如，如果作者想要戏剧化地展现“创造力”这一概念，那么每个演员都可以象征一种艺术形式：诗歌、绘画、舞蹈、音乐、雕塑、电影、戏剧等等。

Archetypal Character: A role that symbolizes a universal concept. Archetypal characters stand for ideals such as Motherhood, Time, Power, Goodness, Evil, Life, Death, and Immortality, in their purest form.

原型人物：象征着普遍概念的角色。原型人物代表着诸如母性、时间、力量、善良、邪恶、生命、死亡和永生等最纯粹的理念。

Cast Map: A display of cast relationships. This graphic maps how characters counterpoint one another’s traits and activate one another’s dimensions.

角色关系图：展示角色之间的关系。此图描绘了角色如何相互制衡彼此的特质，并激活彼此的维度。

Center of Good: A positive quality deep within a primary character. Attributes such as courage, kindness, strength, wisdom, and honesty, usually found in a protagonist, draw a sense of empathy from readers and audiences. This positive center becomes all the more magnetic when it contrasts with negative charges in other cast members or the surrounding society.

善良中心：主角内心深处蕴藏的积极品质。勇气、善良、坚强、智慧和诚实等特质通常体现在主角身上，能够引起读者和观众的共鸣。当这种积极品质与其他角色或周围社会的负面特质形成对比时，它就更具吸引力。

Character Complexity: A pattern of consistent contradictions. These dynamic dimensions structure a character’s outer personality and inner identity.

人物复杂性：一种持续存在的矛盾模式。这些动态维度塑造了人物的外在人格和内在身份。

Character-driven Story: A story in which the principal characters cause the major events. External influences drawn from physical, societal, or coincidental sources have a minor effect.

人物驱动型故事：故事中的主要人物引发重大事件。来自物理、社会或偶然因素的外部影响作用较小。

Characterization: A character’s outer identity. This observable personality combines all of her physical and vocal traits with all the social and personal personae her agent self assumes.

角色刻画：角色的外在身份。这种可观察的个性融合了她所有的生理和语言特征，以及她作为代理人所扮演的所有社会和个人角色。

Core Self: The voice of the mind. When asked “Who am I?” this center of conscious answers “Me” as in “It happened to me ; it’s happening to me now; it might happen to me someday.” This core of awareness observes the agent self as it carries out tasks, and then judges the results. The observer self also studies the people around it, remembering past events, anticipating future events, and fantasizing about impossible events.

核心自我：心灵的声音。当被问及“我是谁？”时，这个意识中心会回答“我”，例如“这件事发生在我身上；它现在正在发生在我身上；它将来可能会发生在我身上”。这个意识核心观察着行动自我执行任务的过程，并评判结果。观察自我也会观察周围的人，回忆过去发生的事情，预测未来发生的事情，并幻想一些不可能发生的事情。

Crisis: A protagonist’s final and most powerful confrontation. In this scene, the story’s maximum forces of antagonism bear down on the protagonist face-to-face, confronting her with a dilemma of possible actions. What she chooses to do climaxes the story.

危机：主人公最终也是最激烈的对抗。在这一幕中，故事中所有敌对势力都正面压向主人公，让她面临抉择的困境。她的最终选择将故事推向高潮。

Depth of Character: Submerged currents of desire and awareness. A quiet stream of knowing flows through the consciousness of profound characters with even weightier perceptions swirling in the silent fathoms below. When audiences and readers identify with these characters, they feel their expansive awareness, read their unexpressed thoughts, and, deeper yet, sense the subconscious desires that shine from behind their eyes.

人物深度：潜藏的欲望与觉知暗流涌动。一股静谧的智慧之流在深刻人物的意识中缓缓流淌，而更为沉重的感知则在寂静的深渊中翻腾。当观众和读者与这些人物产生共鸣时，他们能感受到人物广阔的觉知，读懂人物未曾言说的内心，更深入地，甚至能感受到人物眼底闪烁的潜意识欲望。

Dimension: A living contradiction. Dimensions pivot a character’s behaviors between two opposite qualities or traits. For example, a character who is at times wise but then foolish, who does good then evil, who is generous to some but selfish to others, who is strong in one situation but weak in another.

维度：一种鲜活的矛盾体。维度使角色的行为在两种截然相反的品质或特质之间摇摆不定。例如，一个角色时而睿智，时而愚蠢；时而行善，时而作恶；对某些人慷慨大方，对另一些人却自私自利；在某种情况下强大，在另一种情况下却软弱无力。

Dramatic Irony: The simultaneous awareness of past, present, and future. As a reader’s or audience member’s awareness changes from mystery (knowing less than the characters know) to suspense (knowing the same as the characters know) to dramatic irony (knowing more than the characters know), her curiosity shifts from “What will happen next?” to “How will these characters react when they discover what I already know?” When a storygoer knows what’s going to happen to the characters before it happens, her curiosity morphs into dread and her empathy deepens into compassion.

戏剧性讽刺：同时感知过去、现在和未来。当读者或观众的感知从神秘（知道的比角色少）到悬念（知道的与角色相同）再到戏剧性讽刺（知道的比角色多）时，他们的好奇心也会从“接下来会发生什么？”转变为“当这些角色发现我已经知道的事情时，他们会作何反应？”当故事的观众在事情发生之前就知道角色将要面临的命运时，他们的好奇心会转化为恐惧，他们的同理心也会加深为同情。

Fate: An invisible force that preordains events. Belief in fate arises from the deterministic view that what happens in life is predestined by a godlike power and therefore has to happen. Life’s events, no matter how complex, take one and only one possible course with one and only one possible outcome. In this view, free will is an illusion.

命运：一种预先决定事件发生的无形力量。对命运的信仰源于决定论的观点，即人生中发生的一切都由某种神力预先决定，因此必然发生。人生中的事件，无论多么复杂，都只有一种可能的发展路径和结果。在这种观点看来，自由意志只是一种幻觉。

First-Person Narrator: A voice that tells a fictional story as if it were an autobiography. The author restricts this narrator’s knowledge to what one person could know.

第一人称叙述：以自传式的口吻讲述虚构故事。作者将叙述者的认知范围限制在一个人的认知范围内。

Focal Character: The role that draws most interest. A cast’s focal character is almost always the protagonist, but in rare cases, a distinctive supporting role can take the spotlight.

焦点角色：最吸引观众的角色。通常情况下，主角是剧中的焦点角色，但在少数情况下，一个独特的配角也可能成为焦点。

Foil Character: A role that illuminates the protagonist. A foil’s contrasting qualities help define the protagonist, but when necessary, this character may also explain or interpret a distant or mysterious protagonist.

反面角色：一个衬托主角的角色。反面角色的对比特质有助于塑造主角，必要时，该角色也可以用来解释或诠释疏离或神秘的主角。

Forces of Antagonism: Counteractions that block a character’s desire. These powers arise from the forces of nature, social institutions, personal relationships, or dark impulses within the character herself.

对抗力量：阻碍角色欲望的反作用力。这些力量源于自然之力、社会制度、人际关系，或是角色自身内心的阴暗冲动。

Hidden Self: The subconscious mind. Silent, often contradictory drives percolate below the level of awareness. These psychic energies fuel an identity (courageous, cowardly, kind, cruel, violent, calm, etc.) and reveal themselves when a character reacts spontaneously to sudden pressure.

隐藏的自我：潜意识。无声的、往往相互矛盾的驱动力在意识层面之下涌动。这些心理能量塑造着人格（勇敢、懦弱、善良、残忍、暴力、冷静等等），并在角色对突如其来的压力做出自发反应时显露出来。

Inciting Incident: A story line’s first major turning point. Inciting means “starting with impact”; incident means “event.” This event throws life radically out of balance and arouses the protagonist’s super-objective—her desire to restore equilibrium.

引发事件：故事情节的第一个重大转折点。“引发”意味着“以冲击力开始”；“事件”意味着“事件”。这个事件彻底打破了生活的平衡，并激发了主人公的终极目标——她渴望恢复平衡。

Motivation: An innate craving for satisfaction. All-encompassing motivations such as the need for security, the drive for sex, and the fear of starvation push a character toward specific desires such as a gated community, a sensuous lover, a filling meal. Gratification of these ongoing passions and appetites rarely lasts.

动机：一种与生俱来的对满足的渴望。诸如安全感的需求、性欲的驱使以及对饥饿的恐惧等包罗万象的动机，会驱使角色追求特定的欲望，例如封闭式社区、性感的情人或丰盛的餐食。然而，这些持续不断的激情和欲望的满足往往难以持久。

Object of Desire: What the protagonist wants in an effort to restore the balance of life. It could be something personal or social, mental or physical.

欲望对象：主人公为了恢复生活平衡而渴望的东西。它可以是个人或社会方面的，精神上的或物质上的。

Plot: A story’s ordering, linking, and weaving of events.

情节：故事中事件的排序、联系和交织。

Plot-driven Story: A story in which physical, social, and coincidental forces cause the major events. Influences drawn from the characters’ desires and resources have a secondary effect.

情节驱动型故事：这类故事中，自然因素、社会因素和偶然事件共同推动主要事件的发生。人物的欲望和资源所带来的影响则起到次要作用。

Point-of-View Character: The role that guides the reader/audience through the telling. Most stories follow their protagonist from event to event, but occasionally an author will keep the protagonist at a mysterious distance and narrate from a supporting character’s point of view.

叙述视角人物：引导读者/观众理解故事叙述的角色。大多数故事都跟随主人公经历各种事件，但有时作者会让主人公保持神秘的距离，而从配角的视角进行叙述。

Presentational Genres: Story types based on form: differing styles, tones, or media of expression.

表现体裁：根据形式划分的故事类型：不同的风格、语气或表达媒介。

Primary Genres: Story types based on content: differing characters, events, values, emotions.

主要类型：根据内容划分的故事类型：不同的角色、事件、价值观、情感。

Reliable Narrator: An honest storytelling voice. When authors narrate their stories, they invent a third-person voice with a godlike knowledge of characters and history. When characters narrate, they speak in a first-person voice with knowledge limited to their personal experience. In either case, they are reliable if the reader/audience can trust them not to bend the truth.

可靠的叙述者：诚实的叙述声音。作者叙述故事时，会使用第三人称视角，仿佛拥有上帝般的知识，了解人物和历史。而人物叙述时，则使用第一人称视角，其知识仅限于个人经历。无论哪种情况，只要读者/观众相信他们不会歪曲事实，叙述者就是可靠的。

Resolution: Any scenes or descriptions that follow the climax of the central plot.

结局：指紧随中心情节高潮之后的任何场景或描述。

Reveal: The exposure of a hidden truth.

揭露：曝光隐藏的真相。

Scene-Objective: What a character wants in the immediate moment that will take her a step toward her super-objective.

场景目标：角色在当下想要的东西，能够帮助她朝着最终目标迈进一步。

Service Role: A character whose actions affect the course of a story’s events.

服务角色：其行为会影响故事情节发展的角色。

Stock Role: A character who carries out a task according to her profession or social position but does not affect the course of events.

固定角色：指根据其职业或社会地位执行任务，但不影响事件进程的角色。

Subtext: A character’s unexpressed inner life. Readers and audiences peer through the surface behaviors (text) of a complex character to discover these unsaid and unsayable thoughts, feelings, and drives (subtext).

潜台词：角色未表达的内心世界。读者和观众透过复杂角色的表面行为（文本），去发现这些未说出口或难以言说的想法、感受和动机（潜台词）。

Super-Objective: The need to rebalance life. From the inciting incident on, a protagonist’s super-objective inspires her struggle to reach her object of desire and thus restore life’s equilibrium.

超级目标：重新平衡生活的需要。从事件发生之初，主人公的超级目标就激励着她努力实现渴望的目标，从而恢复生活的平衡。

Supporting Role: A character who facilitates scenes but does not affect the course of events.

配角：一个推动剧情发展但不影响事件走向的角色。

Suspense: Emotional curiosity. A combination of rational interest and empathetic involvement pulls a reader/audience through a story.

悬念：一种情感上的好奇心。理性兴趣与同理心的结合，能够吸引读者/观众沉浸于故事之中。

Telling: A synonym for story.

讲述：故事的同义词。

Text: The sensory surface of a work of art: words on the pages of a novel, sounds and images on-screen, actors and sets onstage.

文本：艺术作品的感官表面：小说书页上的文字、屏幕上的声音和图像、舞台上的演员和布景。

Third-Person Narrator: The voice an author invents to tell her story. This voice treats a fictional work as if it were the biography of its characters. Its knowledge ranges from an omniscient comprehension of a story’s history, setting, and cast to a limited insight into the inner and outer lives of a single character.

第三人称叙述者：作者为了讲述故事而创造的声音。这种叙述方式将虚构作品视为其中人物的传记。其知识面涵盖范围很广，从对故事背景、场景和人物的全知全能，到对单个人物内心世界和外部生活的有限洞察。

True Character: A character’s inner identity comprised of a triad of selves: the conscious Core Self , its active Agent Self , and its subconscious Hidden Self .

真实性格：一个角色的内在身份由三个自我组成：有意识的核心自我、积极的行动自我和潜意识的隐藏自我。

Turning Point: An event that changes the value charge in a character’s life from positive to negative or negative to positive.

转折点：改变角色生活中价值取向的事件，从正面变为负面，或从负面变为正面。

Unreliable Narrators: A confused, ignorant, or dishonest storytelling voice. If an unreliable third-person voice tells a story, he may either warn the reader that he can’t be trusted or just let her figure it out for herself. If an unreliable first-person character narrates, she may be sincere but simply biased or blind to the truth.

不可靠的叙述者：指叙述者语无伦次、无知或不诚实。如果故事由不可靠的第三人称叙述，他可能会警告读者他的话不可信，或者干脆让读者自己去判断。如果故事由不可靠的第一人称叙述，叙述者可能出于真诚，但却带有偏见或对真相视而不见。

Value: A binary of charged experience that can change a human condition from positive to negative or negative to positive: Life/Death, Pleasure/Pain, Justice/Injustice, and the like.

价值：一种二元对立的、充满能量的体验，它可以将人类的境况从积极变为消极，或从消极变为积极：例如，生命/死亡、快乐/痛苦、正义/不正义等等。

Jenann Ismael on the nature of choice: “We are shaped by our native dispositions and endowments, but we do make choices, and our choices… are expressions of our hopes and dreams, values and priorities. These are things actively distilled out of a history of personal experience, and they make us who we are. Freedom is not a grandiose metaphysical ability to subvene the laws of physics. It is the day-to-day business of making choices: choosing the country over the city, children over career, jazz over opera, choosing an occasional lie over a hurtful truth, hard work over leisure. It is choosing that friend, this hairstyle, maybe tiramisu over a tight physique, and pleasure over achievement. It is all of the little formative decisions that when all is said and done, make our lives our own creations.” (“Fate’s Scales, Quivering,” Jenann Ismael, TLS , August 9, 2019.)
11. 珍娜·伊斯梅尔论选择的本质：“我们受与生俱来的性情和天赋塑造，但我们确实会做出选择，而我们的选择……正是我们希望与梦想、价值观和优先事项的表达。这些都是从个人经历中提炼而来的，它们塑造了我们。自由并非凌驾于物理定律之上的宏大形而上学能力，而是日复一日做出选择：选择乡村而非城市，选择孩子而非事业，选择爵士乐而非歌剧，选择偶尔撒谎而非说出伤人的真相，选择努力工作而非休闲。它意味着选择那个朋友，选择这种发型，或许选择提拉米苏而非健美的身材，选择享乐而非成就。正是所有这些看似微小却意义深远的决定，最终成就了我们自己的人生。”（《命运的天平，颤抖》，珍娜·伊斯梅尔，《泰晤士报文学增刊》，2019年8月9日。）
12 . Free Will and Luck , Alfred R. Mele, Oxford University Press, 2008; Effective Intentions: The Power of Conscious Will , Alfred R. Mele, Oxford University Press, 2009.
